description: This Java class represents a context object for processing CoAP requests within the Eclipse Hono project. It encapsulates the CoAP exchange details and timing information for request processing.

classes.name: CoapContext
classes.description: A class that holds context information for a CoAP request, including the request exchange object and a timing sample, extending MapBasedExecutionContext for additional contextual data.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of CoapContext from a CoapExchange request, optionally including a timer.

methods.name: getExchange
methods.description: Returns the CoapExchange object associated with this context.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Returns the timer object used for measuring request processing time.

methods.name: respondWithCode
methods.description: Sends a response to the device with the specified response code.
